# Ho-Smart v0.2.1 — Preserve local availability during cloud outages

**Focus:** Stop intermittent Ho-Smart cloud-history failures from unnecessarily making the entire integration unavailable in Hybrid mode.

## Why this update was developed

Hybrid mode combines independent sources: local Security1 receiver status and cloud alarm history. When the cloud endpoint times out or returns malformed data, healthy local receiver entities should remain usable.

## What changed

- Fixed a v0.2.0 availability regression that could mark the whole coordinator unavailable on an unexpected cloud/history failure.
- Preserved local receiver status and entities when cloud-history requests fail in Hybrid mode.
- Added defensive handling for invalid or absent cloud alarm-history timestamps.
- Backfilled the node identifier into older configuration entries after a successful local refresh.
- Retained Cloud-only mode's appropriate unavailable behavior when its cloud source is down.

## Limitations and testing

The update improves **availability isolation**, not vendor alarm generation. A cloud outage can still delay the driveway-alarm event itself even while local receiver status remains online.

## Installation

Update through HACS and restart Home Assistant. Existing receiver configuration and credentials remain unchanged.

**Full changelog:** [Compare v0.2.0...v0.2.1](https://github.com/gigabytegrove/hosmart-home-assistant/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1)
